Package game.actions

Interface TravelMethod

All Known Implementing Classes:
AlienDevice, Ladder, TeleportationCircle, TravelGround
public interface TravelMethod
A way of travelling to a destination: a ladder, a teleportation circle, an alien device, or any mechanism added later.

Every method has a default, so a mechanism only overrides the part in which it differs: where the Actor really ends up (chooseLanding(edu.monash.fit2099.engine.actors.Actor, edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.GameMap, edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Location)) and what happens on arrival (onArrival(edu.monash.fit2099.engine.actors.Actor, edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Location)).

  • Method Details

    • chooseLanding

      default Location chooseLanding(Actor actor, GameMap map, Location intended)
      Decides where the Actor really lands. By default this is exactly the intended destination; an unreliable mechanism can override this to land the Actor elsewhere.
      Parameters:
      actor - the Actor who is travelling
      map - the map the Actor is currently on
      intended - the Location the Actor chose to travel to
      Returns:
      the Location the Actor lands on

    • onArrival

      default String onArrival(Actor actor, Location landing)
      Applies whatever happens once the Actor has arrived. By default nothing happens.
      Parameters:
      actor - the Actor who has just arrived
      landing - the Location the Actor landed on
      Returns:
      a description of what happened, or an empty string if nothing did
